prompt:
Create a native high fidelity illustrated game sprite atlas of THE FURY, original Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater, original 2004 PlayStation 2 incarnation, using the supplied actual original reference images. This is a faithful costume/equipment adaptation, not Delta. Output native transparent RGBA PNG, no background. Exactly TWELVE entirely separate complete full-body figures, on a FOUR COLUMN by THREE ROW evenly spaced grid, read left to right top to bottom. Each figure fits wholly within its cell with 40 pixels of empty alpha between figures and 30 pixels at outer image edges. Prefer wide 1536 x 1024 sheet. All figures face screen LEFT, fixed orthographic side / three-quarter fighting-game projection, same design and same standing body scale, clean detailed hand-painted 2D sprite art, restrained neutral material palette. No text labels, no cell lines, no shadows, no detached equipment or extra persons.

Original FURY identity must follow Konami model and actual PS2 captures: black/dark charcoal ribbed padded Soviet cosmonaut suit, copper/bronze-dark rounded closed helmet and visor with the original three Cyrillic characters БЕЙ across its front, face hidden beneath closed reflective visor (no exposed face, no modern visor greebles). Broad high charcoal neck seal, very thin restrained bronze seam accents, closed black gloves, padded black trousers and original angular heavy black high boots. Compact paired PALE BEIGE/GREY vertical tanks attached to his BACK; original thin black transverse triangular booms extend behind shoulder plane with small outer jet nozzles, as real 21845/21885s capture. These are not mechanical wings and not body armor. Original long tubular black flamethrower in ANATOMICAL RIGHT hand with rear trigger grip, simple forward barrel muzzle and a hose that stays connected to the BACK tank. Left hand can support tube but never hold a second gun. Never exchange right/left anatomy; actual right-hand grip remains anatomical right when three-quarter view changes. No camouflage, no bare face, no NASA patch, no rifle stock, no glowing tubes. No flames, thruster exhaust, aura, smoke, projectiles, scenery or particles baked into body figures. Tank and weapon remain attached to one figure, every hose connected and NOT touching adjacent figures.

This sheet B has EXACTLY these twelve isolated authored versus poses, all facing screen LEFT:
Sequence in strict four-column grid: 0 close jab startup right elbow cocked while the flamethrower hangs lowered in right glove against hip; 1 jab active LEFT glove punching forward LEFT while RIGHT hand holds lowered weapon close to the waist; 2 jab recovery left arm returning, weapon still right.
3 heavy strike startup, original right-held flamethrower lifted slightly for a physical butt/tube strike; 4 heavy physical tube contact strike pushed forward LEFT with both hands on original connected tube, right-hand trigger grip unchanged; 5 heavy recovery retracting flamethrower to low guard.
6 low boot sweep startup deep squat, gun held close lower torso; 7 active low boot sweep right leg extended toward LEFT, body low and visor LEFT, no gunfire; 8 boot sweep recovery bringing leg in, gun close; 9 recoiling hit upright armor rocked backwards, visor still LEFT; 10 KO knees buckling and body falling backward LEFT, visor nose still LEFT; 11 KO fully down lying on left side/back with helmet facing LEFT and flamethrower tube still connected to backpack resting in right hand, feet body horizontal. Exactly one figure in each cell, no opponent, no extra limbs.
All equipment connected to same figure; no movement trails/flames or stray detached weapon. This is gameplay adaptation, no blades, no fists through gun handles. Use completed A LEFT design as consistent identity; never expose face or swap the gun into anatomical left hand. Frame8 is crouched recovery; do not fill the cell by inflating crouched body scale. All figures isolated transparent gaps.
Grid assignment is unambiguous: TOP ROW four cells = poses 0,1,2,3. MIDDLE ROW four cells = poses 4,5,6,7. BOTTOM ROW four cells = poses 8,9,10,11. Three rows with FOUR figures each; never three figures then six.
Every face points LEFT and attacks extend LEFT. Independently draw the opposite view, not a pixel mirror. Original visor БЕЙ stays readable; flamethrower belongs to anatomical RIGHT hand in both views; LEFT jab strikes LEFT while original right-held tube remains down. B10 falling pose visor points LEFT and B11 horizontal defeated helmet points LEFT.
CRITICAL CORRECTION: the earlier B sheet retained wrong RIGHT-facing poses. This output must be TWELVE independently drawn LEFT-facing figures. Use attached A LEFT sheet as sole body-view orientation guide. Helmet fronts with inscription lie toward LEFT of helmet center in EVERY pose; dark BACKPACK tanks and nozzles lie BEHIND him toward RIGHT. Jab glove extends LEFT, tube/barrel extends LEFT, low boot extends LEFT; no single right-facing stance. TOP ROW 0 jab windup,1 active LEFTward left-hand jab,2 jab recovery,3 heavy windup; MIDDLE ROW 4 active LEFTward physical tube strike,5 heavy recovery,6 low sweep windup,7 active LEFTward boot sweep; BOTTOM ROW 8 low recovery,9 hit recoil,10 falling backward RIGHT while helmet faces LEFT,11 KO horizontal helmet on screenLEFT and boots on screenRIGHT, original connected gun pointing LEFT. All 12 noses point LEFT, all actions aligned LEFT. True alpha with isolated complete figures and generous gap, no cloning/mirroring tools.
